description_en: Modifies the scaling rule for an application
description_zh: 调用ModifyScalingRule接口修改弹性扩、缩容规则
name: ModifyScalingRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance group to which the application is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 部署分组ID
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The relationship among the conditions that trigger a scale-in.

OR: one of the conditions

AND: all conditions
parameters.help_zh:
触发条件。

OR：任一条件
AND：所有条件
parameters.name: in_condition

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow scale-ins.

true: allows scale-ins.

false: does not allow scale-ins
parameters.help_zh:
是否包含缩容规则。

true：包含
false：不包含
parameters.name: in_enable

parameters.help_en: The CPU utilization that triggers a scale-in
parameters.help_zh: 触发指标：CPU使用率
parameters.name: in_cpu

parameters.help_en: The duration in which the metric threshold is exceeded. Unit: minutes
parameters.help_zh: 持续时间，单位为分钟
parameters.name: in_duration

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of instances that must be retained in each group when a scale-in is performed
parameters.help_zh: 分组缩容时需要保留的最小实例数
parameters.name: in_instance_num

parameters.help_en: The system load that triggers a scale-in
parameters.help_zh: 触发指标：系统负载
parameters.name: in_load

parameters.help_en: The minimum service latency that triggers a scale-in. The lower limit is 0. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 触发指标：服务时延。单位为毫秒，最小值为0
parameters.name: in_rt

parameters.help_en: The number of instances that are removed during each scale-in
parameters.help_zh: 每次缩容的实例数
parameters.name: in_step

parameters.help_en:
The relationship among the conditions that trigger a scale-out.

OR: one of the conditions

AND: all conditions
parameters.help_zh:
触发条件。

OR：任一条件
AND：所有条件
parameters.name: out_condition

parameters.help_en: The CPU utilization that triggers a scale-out
parameters.help_zh: 触发指标：CPU使用率
parameters.name: out_cpu

parameters.help_en: The duration in which the metric threshold is exceeded. Unit: minutes
parameters.help_zh: 持续时间，单位为分钟
parameters.name: out_duration

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to allow scale-outs
parameters.help_zh: 是否包含扩容规则
parameters.name: out_enable

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of instances in each group when a scale-out is performed
parameters.help_zh: 分组扩容时的最大实例数
parameters.name: out_instance_num

parameters.help_en: The system load that triggers a scale-out
parameters.help_zh: 触发指标：系统负载
parameters.name: out_load

parameters.help_en: The minimum service latency that triggers a scale-out. The lower limit is 0. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 触发指标：服务时延。单位为毫秒，最小值为0
parameters.name: out_rt

parameters.help_en: The number of instances that are added during each scale-out
parameters.help_zh: 每次扩容的实例数
parameters.name: out_step

parameters.help_en:
The source of the instance to be added during a scale-out. Valid values:

NEW: elastic resources

AVAILABLE: existing resources If you prefer existing resources to elastic resources, set this parameter to AVAILABLE_FIRST.

If you set this parameter to NEW or AVAILABLE_FIRST, you must specify the auto-scaling parameters. If you set this parameter to NEW, instances are created based on a launch template or the specifications of an existing instance
parameters.help_zh:
扩容实例来源。
NEW：弹性资源。
AVAILABLE：已有资源。已有资源优先为AVAILABLE_FIRST。

NEW或AVAILABLE_FIRST需指定弹性扩容参数，弹性扩容包括两种模式：启动模版和基于现有实例规则
parameters.name: resource_from

parameters.help_en:
The multi-zone scaling policy. Valid values:

PRIORITY: The vSwitch that is first selected has the highest priority.

BALANCE: This policy evenly distributes instances across zones in which the vSwitches reside
parameters.help_zh:
弹性扩容的多可用区扩缩容策略。包含两种策略：
PRIORITY：优先级策略。
BALANCE：均衡分布策略
parameters.name: multi_az_policy

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) that is associated with the instances created based on a launch template or the specifications of an existing instance
parameters.help_zh: 弹性扩容的“启动模版”或“基于现有实例规则”所关联的VPC ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the vSwitches that are associated with the VPC. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: VPC相关的vswitch ID列表，多个以半角逗号（,）分割
parameters.name: vswitchids

parameters.help_en:
The instance handling mode during a scale-in. Valid values:

release: When a scale-in is performed, instances that are no longer used are released.

recycle: When a scale-in is performed, instances that are no longer used are stopped and reclaimed
parameters.help_zh:
弹性缩容的回收模式。
release：释放模式
recycle：停机回收模式
parameters.name: scaling_policy

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance whose specifications are used to create instances during a scale-out. This parameter is valid only when you set the OutEnable parameter to true
parameters.help_zh: 弹性扩容“基于现有实例规则”的实例ID。OutEnable为true（真）才有效
parameters.name: template_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the instance whose specifications are used to create instances during a scale-out. This parameter takes effect only if you specify the TemplateInstanceId parameter
parameters.help_zh: 弹性扩容“基于现有实例规则”的实例名称。TemplateInstanceId存在才有效
parameters.name: template_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The password that is used to log on to the instance. This parameter takes effect only if you choose to create instances based on the specifications of an existing instance during a scale-out
parameters.help_zh: 实例登录密码。当弹性扩容使用“基于现有实例规则”才有效
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: The key pair that is used to log on to the instance. This parameter takes effect only if you choose to create instances based on the specifications of an existing instance during a scale-out
parameters.help_zh: 实例登录密钥名称。当弹性扩容使用“基于现有实例规则”才有效
parameters.name: key_pair_name

parameters.help_en: Set the value to true if scale-outs are allowed
parameters.help_zh: 若使用弹性扩容，则必须设置为true
parameters.name: accept_eula

parameters.help_en: The ID of the launch template that is used to create instances during a scale-out. This parameter takes effect only if you set the OutEnable parameter to true. This parameter takes precedence over the TemplateInstanceId parameter
parameters.help_zh: 弹性扩容“启动模版”ID。OutEnable为true（真）才有效，优先级高于TemplateInstanceId
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The version of the launch template that is used to create instances during a scale-out. This parameter takes effect only if you set the OutEnable parameter to true. To use the default template version, set this parameter to `-1`. Otherwise, set this parameter to the version that you want to use
parameters.help_zh: 弹性扩容“启动模版”版本。OutEnable为true（真）才有效。若使用默认模版，则设置为`-1`，否则设置为相应的版本号
parameters.name: template_version

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code that is returned
